goal: Implement R-006 backpressure policy selector with DROP_NEW, DROP_OLD, BLOCK, and OVERFLOW_TO_DISK exposed via GraphPartitionRunner.Builder.
requirements: Add BackpressurePolicy enum and per-edge config.
Implement overflow-to-disk via mmap spill file.
Test all four policies under sustained overrun.
Assert spill file reads back correctly on drain.
constraints: Do not add cross-partition backpressure propagation.
Reuse MmapJournal machinery from lvc-standard instead of inventing a new spill format.
acceptance_criteria: Test matrix covers DROP_NEW, DROP_OLD, BLOCK, and OVERFLOW_TO_DISK under sustained overrun.
Overflow-to-disk spill file drains and reads back correctly.
